map.可复现算例：30 岁最大心率与区间: Reproducible example: maximum heart rate and zones for a 30-year-old
map.输入：年龄 30 岁。\n四式：Fox=220−30=190；Tanaka=20:
Input: age 30.
Four formulas: Fox=220−30=190; Tanaka=208−0.7×30=187; Gellish=207−0.7×30=186; Arena=209−0.6×30=191.
Average maximum heart rate avg=round((190+187+186+191)/4)=round(188.5)=189 bpm.
Five zones (of avg's
map.）：热身/恢复 50–60%→95–113、燃脂/基础 60–70%→113–1:
): warm-up/recovery 50–60%→95–113, fat burning/base 60–70%→113–132, aerobic endurance 70–80%→132–151, anaerobic threshold 80–90%→151–170, VO2max 90–95%→170–180 bpm.
Conclusion: a 30-year-old's aerobic endurance zone is about 132–151 bpm; use it to pace or to control intensity from a heart-rate strap.
map.四个公式哪个最准？: Which of the four formulas is the most accurate?
map.Fox(220−年龄)最经典但个体差异大；Tanaka(208−0.7age)、: Fox (220 − age) is the most classic but has large individual variation; Tanaka (208 − 0.7×age), Gellish (207 − 0.7×age) and Arena (209 − 0.6×age) are more modern regressions and generally run 1-5 bpm higher than Fox. Averaging the four is the safest, and this tool gives the average and each zone directly.
map.区间怎么用？: How do I use the zones?
map.燃脂/基础(60–70%)适合减脂有氧；有氧耐力(70–80%)提升心肺；无氧阈: Fat burning/base (60–70%) suits fat-loss cardio; aerobic endurance (70–80%) improves cardiorespiratory fitness; anaerobic threshold (80–90%) raises the lactate threshold. Beginners should start from Z1–Z2 and progress gradually, not sprint into the high zone every time.
